get.description:
All providers, or with `is_member` the ones the owner of the token is an approved member of (`true`) or all the others (`false`). Sorted by abbreviation without case, then by id; pages count from 0 and `pageSize` is at most 100 (default 100). `totalCount` is the size of the filtered set. The contact point of a provider is never part of this API.

Needs the scope `registry.organisations.v1.read`.

get.description:
The services, each once, whatever the number of its consortia (`[]` for none). A service that is not public is listed too, with `public: false`. Filters are combined with AND; a comma-separated list inside one filter is OR, compared without case (at most 50 values). An abbreviation that names no service or provider, a stage or licence that names nothing and a category that is no KPI set name is 422. Sorted by abbreviation without case, then by id; pages count from 0 and `pageSize` is at most 100 (default 100). `totalCount` is the size of the filtered set. The contact point of a service is never part of this API.

Needs the scope `registry.services.v1.read`.

get.description:
The KPI sets (the legacy "categories"), each once. Sorted by name without case, then by id; pages count from 0 and `pageSize` is at most 100 (default 100). `totalCount` is the number of sets.

Needs the scope `kpi.framework.v1.read`.

result.description: Services that offer data to researchers.

id.description: The id of the KPI set (a UUID).

indicators.description: How many indicators the set has.

get.description:
The indicators. `category` (the name of a KPI set, without case) keeps the indicators of that set and gives their necessity in it. `service` (the abbreviation of a service, without case) marks the indicators of its effective KPI set with `selected: true` and, without `category`, gives their necessity there; it does not remove the others. A `category` that names no set and a `service` that names no service is 422. Sorted by name without case, then by id; pages count from 0 and `pageSize` is at most 100 (default 100). `totalCount` is the size of the filtered set.

Needs the scope `kpi.framework.v1.read`.

necessity.description: A term of the vocabulary `necessity`: the necessity in the set asked for with `category`, else in the effective KPI set of the service asked for with `service`, else `null`.
